shots.detail_en: SD1 and SD2 press against the flipping-board screen before the opening bell, hunting loudly for the floor-mopping mystery predictor as morning light cuts through the gate.
shots.sub: 散户甲："三点位！全中！——人呢？昨天那个扫地的呢？"散户乙："扫地僧！找着没有？"
shots.speaker: 散户甲/散户乙
shots.fx: flipping-board clatter, rising crowd murmur, BP-bleeper chirps

shots.detail_en: CH mops his corner in the same unhurried S-line while SD1 squeezes over and claps his shoulder.
shots.sub: 散户甲："陆先生！今天带哪只？"
shots.speaker: 散户甲
shots.fx: mop water sloshing over hall roar

shots.detail_en: CH stares at the floor's reflection and wipes SD1's shoe edge clean with one stroke, never lifting his gaze.
shots.sub: 长虹："我只管地干净不干净。"
shots.speaker: 长虹
shots.fx: one crisp mop stroke, ambient noise dips a beat

shots.detail_en: XTC stands behind the second-floor VIP glass aiming a brass telescope at the corner below, prayer beads dangling from his wrist.
shots.sub: 熊天成："扫地的时候……眼神也不扫地。"
shots.speaker: 熊天成
shots.fx: telescope focus click + low menace motif

shots.detail_en: XTC's prayer beads freeze mid-turn, one bead pinched between his fingers as he calls into the shadows behind him.
shots.sub: 熊天成："伟仔，过来。"
shots.speaker: 熊天成
shots.fx: bead clatter cut dead

shots.detail_en: XW steps to his father's side in his all-black suit, laptop light on his rimless glasses, both staring down through the glass at the mopping figure.
shots.sub: 熊伟："爸，我用联华机电喂一段假行情——看他接不接。"
shots.speaker: 熊伟
shots.fx: air-con hum + cold electronic motif

shots.detail_en: XW types without a flicker of expression, scrolling data streams reflected across his lenses.
shots.sub: 熊伟："我不问他——我让数据替我问一句话。"
shots.speaker: 熊伟
shots.fx: keyboard burst + data-stream tone

shots.detail_en: CROWD lifts its heads as the opening bell strikes and the Lianhua Jidian board flips green-to-red column by column, PA echoing the screen.
shots.sub: 广播（画外）："联华机电，放量上攻——价升量增！"
shots.speaker: 广播（画外）
shots.fx: opening bell + board-flip roar + PA static

shots.detail_en: CROWD floods from the big screen toward the order counter, paper slips crushed in fists, red-vest brokers swallowed by bodies.
shots.sub: 散户群："快！联华机电！"散户乙："冲了冲了！"
shots.speaker: 散户群/散户乙
shots.fx: camera tremor + explosive crowd surge

shots.detail_en: MC squeezes out of the pack in his loud flower shirt, hip BP-bleeper jumping so hard it bounces, one hand slapping the counter.
shots.sub: 满仓："这波不跟——我满仓俩字倒着写！全仓！！"
shots.speaker: 满仓
shots.fx: zoomed BP-bleeper buzz + comic string stab

shots.detail_en: CH's mop-holding hand pins the order slip flat before MC's pen can land, eyes on the form, not the face.
shots.sub: 长虹："抢在最前面的人，站在刀口上。"满仓："刀口？哪有刀？！"
shots.speaker: 长虹/满仓
shots.fx: paper rustle + one-beat rest, hall noise muted

shots.detail_en: CROWD roars as the entire flipping board turns red and a fat bull candle rips upward on the chart, red light washing over upraised order slips.
shots.sub: 散户群："拉了！！真的拉了！！"
shots.speaker: 散户群
shots.fx: full-hall roar + giant board clatter + theme motif detonation

shots.detail_en: CH mops at the very edge of the roaring pack without so much as a flicker of his eyelids, red light sweeping past his profile.
shots.fx: music drops to silence, only mop water sound (silent beat)

shots.detail_en: CROWD freezes mid-cheer as the board flips red-to-green column by column and the chart line dives straight down, fresh chase slips still raised.
shots.sub: 散户乙（僵住）："……我单刚交上去啊……"
shots.speaker: 散户乙
shots.fx: cold board flips one by one, roar cut off

shots.detail_en: MC's pen hangs suspended above the slip, a sweat bead sliding down his temple as he twists around to find CH already gone.
shots.sub: 满仓（后怕）："刀口……真有刀。"
shots.speaker: 满仓
shots.fx: sweat drop on paper + single heartbeat

shots.detail_en: CH wrings the mop over the bucket, one glance up at the screen, then back down to the floor.
shots.sub: 长虹："行情要扫，地也要扫。"
shots.speaker: 长虹
shots.fx: mop wringing + residual hall noise

shots.detail_en: XW tilts his laptop toward his father, CH's account-path chart a dead-flat line with zero orders logged, XTC leaning in.
shots.sub: 熊伟："全程零委托、零回头——反应：零。"
shots.speaker: 熊伟
shots.fx: data-stream tone closing cold + air-con hum

shots.detail_en: XTC folds the telescope, mercy and blade in the same smile, prayer beads resuming their slow orbit.
shots.sub: 熊天成："越不动的人，越值得看。"
shots.speaker: 熊天成
shots.fx: telescope click + bead chime + low motif

shots.detail_en: XTC slides open a teak drawer at the VIP desk, lifts out a yellowed old photograph and brushes the dust away with his thumb, almost devout.
shots.fx: wooden drawer rail + fingertip on photo paper

shots.detail_en: FATHER, a young man in the rain-lit 1993 trading hall, turns back with a smile, hand-drawn candlestick notebook tucked under his arm, film grain over everything.
shots.sub: 陆振海："牛市没有眼泪。"
shots.speaker: 陆振海
shots.fx: flashback reverb + old film grain hiss

shots.detail_en: XTC holds the yellowed photo beside the telescope's round frame where CH's mopping silhouette glows below, two faces overlapping in light and shade.
shots.sub: 熊天成（画外低语）："老陆……你家这孩子，回来了？"
shots.speaker: 熊天成（画外）
shots.fx: one low suspense motif + telescope metal ring-out

shots.detail_en: Black end card with white Chinese text fading in.
shots.sub: 一张旧照片，一杯请你的茶。
shots.speaker: 字幕
shots.fx: suspense resolve sting + one clock tick
shots.card: 一张旧照片，一杯请你的茶。
